name: LED indicator (5 V, 330 Ω, red LED)
description: A DC supply drives a red indicator LED through a current-limiting resistor. The simplest complete circuit and the primary, fully tested reference.
expected_behavior: About 9.09 mA flows through R1 and D1 (assuming a 2.0 V LED forward voltage); R1 drops about 3 V and dissipates about 27.3 mW; VCC = 5 V and LED_A ≈ 2.0 V relative to GND.
example_questions: What is the purpose of R1?
Why might the LED be dim?
